headlines.title: Singapore-based investors now the top non-local buyers of Hong Kong office assets
headlines.summary:
Singapore-based investors have become the largest group of non-local buyers of commercial properties in Hong Kong, drawn by the sizeable correction in the prices of distressed assets amid a slump in the city’s office segment, according to Colliers.
The demand from Singapore was likely to remain steady in the coming months, given that the prices of office assets have declined by as much as 50 per cent, according to Thomas Chak, head of capital markets and investment services at the property...
headlines.title_zh: 新加坡投资者现已成为香港写字楼资产的最大海外买家
headlines.summary_zh: 据高力国际（Colliers）称，由于香港写字楼市场低迷，不良资产价格大幅回调，吸引新加坡投资者成为香港商业地产最大的非本地买家群体。未来几个月，鉴于写字楼资产价格走势，来自新加坡的需求可能保持稳定。

headlines.title: AI改变经济运行底层逻辑 专家表示实施“投资于人”的战略
headlines.summary: 随着人工智能（AI）与各领域加速融合，AI不仅成为资本市场高度关注的投资热点，还在改变宏观经济运行的底层逻辑。 国家统计局日前发布的最新数据显示，今年上半年我国规模以上工业企业营业收入同比增长6.5%，其中，电子行业利润同比增长96.9%，成为规上工业企业利润较快增长的重要支撑。国家统计局工业司首席统计师于卫宁介绍，这主要得益于AI与各领域加速融合，算力需求大幅增长。 北京大学国家发展研究院院长黄益平认为，当前AI并未显著提升全要素生产率，这属于技术落地的短期滞后现象。随着产业调整、资源优化配置逐步完成，AI将成为经济增长的核心动力。 着眼于进一步推动A

headlines.title_en: AI Changes the Underlying Logic of Economic Operations; Experts Say Implement 'Investing in People' Strategy
headlines.summary_en: As AI accelerates across sectors, it is not only a market investment hotspot but is also reshaping macroeconomic fundamentals. NBS data shows H1 industrial firms' revenue up 6.5% YoY, with electronics profit surging 96.9%, largely due to AI integration boosting computing demand, per NBS statistician Yu Weining. PKU's Huang Yiping believes AI has yet to significantly lift TFP, a short-term lag, but will become a core growth driver once adjustments complete.

headlines.title: 高盛仍看多日本AI板块：暴跌后反成买入良机
headlines.summary: 高盛表示，日本AI相关股票的急剧抛售已创造买入机会，并认为强劲的盈利前景可能重振投资者对半导体股票的兴趣。高盛首席日本股票策略师Bruce Kirk表示，此轮回调降低了盈利打动投资者的门槛，使得许多AI相关股票处于业绩超预期可能对股价产生更大影响的水平。他表示：“只要你认为地缘政治局势不会出现实质性恶化，目前水平似乎是增持某些头寸的好时机。我们认为人工智能的故事还没有结束。”Kirk预计投资者关注点将回归基本面。“最终，一切将取决于盈利，”他表示。“在比6月底低得多的水平上，强劲的业绩应能让投资者重新聚焦于AI的盈利故事。”不过，Kirk预计短期内波动仍

headlines.title_en: Goldman Sachs Still Bullish on Japan's AI Sector: Plunge Turns Into Buying Opportunity
headlines.summary_en: Goldman Sachs says the sharp selloff in Japan's AI-related stocks has created a buying opportunity, noting strong earnings outlooks could revive investor interest in semiconductor stocks. Chief Japan equity strategist Bruce Kirk said the pullback lowers the bar for earnings surprises, making many AI stocks sensitive to beats. He added, 'As long as geopolitical tensions don't materially worsen, current levels seem a good time to add positions. The AI story is not over.' He expects focus to return to fundamentals, with earnings ultimately key.

headlines.title: Big Short trader Michael Burry’s rising bearish AI positions test China’s stock support
headlines.summary:
China’s state support for its stock markets may face a test, as seasoned US hedge fund manager Michael Burry increased bearish wagers on artificial intelligence-linked stocks and Moody’s warned of debt risks from hyperscalers.
Burry, famed for his prescient short against the US property market before the 2008 global financial crisis, expanded positions against Nvidia, Micron Technology and an exchange-traded fund tracking the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index.

headlines.title_zh: 大空头交易员迈克尔·伯里看空人工智能头寸增加，考验中国股市支撑
headlines.summary_zh: 中国对股市的国家支持可能面临考验，因资深美国对冲基金经理迈克尔·伯里（Michael Burry）增加对人工智能相关股票的看空押注，且穆迪（Moody's）警告超大规模数据中心存在债务风险。以在2008年全球金融危机前精准做空美国房地产市场而闻名的伯里，再次扩大了持仓。

headlines.title: Price of parenting: the household maths giving China’s consumers pause
headlines.summary:
Qiu Huiying, a human resources manager in Guangdong, worries in numerical terms when she looks ahead to the next decade: a 20-year mortgage, a 10 per cent loss on her property and thousands of yuan in monthly childcare costs that are set to rise.
She bought a 624 sq ft flat last year, so her mother-in-law could move in and help care for her son. But the purchase now feels less prudent after prices in the 20-year-old complex have already fallen by about 10 per cent.

headlines.title_zh: 育儿成本：让中国消费者踌躇的家庭经济账
headlines.summary_zh: 广东人力资源经理邱慧莹（音译）在展望未来十年时，以数字表达忧虑：20年期的房贷、房产贬值10%、每月数千元且还在上涨的育儿费用。她去年购入一套624平方英尺的公寓，以便婆婆搬来帮忙照顾儿子。但购房……

headlines.title: A股定增一览：6家公司披露定增进展
headlines.summary: Wind数据显示，7月29日，A股共6家公司发布定增相关公告。其中1家公司披露股票定增预案，2家定增预案获股东大会通过，2家定增预案获交易所通过，1家定增预案获证监会通过。从当日最新披露定增预案来看，立昂技术定增募资预案金额最高，拟定增不超2.55亿元。今年以来，已有104家公司公告定增方案已完成，37家公司定增金额超10亿元。具体来看，中国国航、中国神华、松发股份定增募资金额最高，募资总额分别为200.0亿元、200.0亿元、70.0亿元。

headlines.title_en: A-Share Private Placements Update: 6 Companies Disclose Progress
headlines.summary_en: Wind data shows on July 29, six A-share companies announced private placement-related filings. One disclosed a draft plan, two passed shareholder meetings, two passed exchange reviews, and one passed CSRC approval. Lixon Technology had the highest proposed amount at up to 255 million yuan. Year-to-date, 104 companies have completed private placements, with 37 raising over 1 billion yuan. Top amounts: Air China, 20.0 billion yuan; China Shenhua, 20.0 billion yuan; Songfa Ceramics, 7.0 billion yuan.

headlines.title: 未来产业热门项目估值“一周一变”，创投机构忙中选优
headlines.summary: “好项目抢得厉害，估值越抬越高！”“刚过一周，估值又涨了。”近期，以AI大模型、具身智能为代表的未来产业“吸金”不断，一级市场投资人忙于找项目，担心错过潜在明星项目。清科研究数据显示：2026年上半年，股权投资市场共完成5944起投资案例，同比上升14.7%；投资金额约为5654亿元，同比上升31.9%。市场活跃度已重回高位。从业内获悉，今年以来，创投机构投资节奏明显提速。前沿硬科技步入技术落地周期，资本市场持续拓宽科创企业上市路径，多重合力共同提振一级市场投资信心。（上证报）

headlines.title_en: Valuations of Popular Future Industry Projects 'Change Weekly'; VCs Pick Winners Amid Rush
headlines.summary_en: 'Good projects are fiercely competed for, valuations keep rising!' 'Valuations jumped again in just a week.' Recently, future industries like AI large models and embodied intelligence are attracting heavy investment. Primary market investors are busy hunting for projects, fearing missing out on potential stars. Zero2IPO data shows H1 2026 saw 5,944 investment deals, up 14.7% YoY, with amount of 565.4 billion yuan, up 31.9%. Market activity returned to highs. Sources say VC investment pace has accelerated notably this year, with hard tech entering commercialization, capital markets widening IPO paths for tech firms, boosting confidence in primary markets (Shanghai Securities News).

headlines.title: 港股迎来解禁高峰
headlines.summary: 进入2026年下半年，港股市场迎来限售股解禁高峰期。多家机构测算，2026年港股全年解禁规模或接近2万亿港元，较2025年大幅增长，今年7月、9月和12月成为筹码集中释放的重要时点。不过，从历史经验及近期市场表现看，机构普遍认为，解禁不等同于减持，其影响更多集中于部分流通盘较小、解禁比例较高的个股，尚不足以对港股大盘构成系统性冲击。与此同时，南向资金在部分核心标的上仍展现出较强的定向承接力，多家上市公司的基石投资者、战略股东及管理层也主动延长锁定期或作出不减持承诺，凸显长期资金对优质港股资产的认可。（中证报）

headlines.title_en: Hong Kong Stocks Face Peak Lockup Expiry
headlines.summary_en: Entering H2 2026, Hong Kong stocks face a peak period of locked-up share expirations. Multiple institutions estimate total HK market lock-up expiration scale could approach HK$2 trillion for 2026, up sharply from 2025, with July, September, and December key months. However, based on historical experience and recent performance, institutions generally believe lock-up expiration does not equal selling, with impact more limited to stocks with small float and high release ratios, unlikely to systematically shock the broader market. Meanwhile, southbound funds show strong targeted absorption in core stocks; several listed companies' cornerstone investors, strategic shareholders, and management proactively extend lock-up periods or commit not to sell, reflecting long-term capital's recognition of quality HK-listed assets (China Securities Journal).

headlines.title: AI算力需求催热上半年业绩，行业人士称MLCC产业链高景气度下半年将延续
headlines.summary: 今年以来，受益于AI算力需求爆发，素有“电子工业大米”之称的MLCC（片式多层陶瓷电容器）供应紧俏，价格持续上涨，带动被动元器件行业景气度回升，多家上市公司预计上半年业绩实现大幅增长，最高增幅超过6倍。展望下半年，有行业人士表示，7月以来，MLCC价格整体平稳，品类内部价格则分化加剧，AI和车规级高端高容产品价格继续上涨。在AI服务器需求旺盛、原厂产能被锁定、上游贵金属等原材料价格居高的背景下，预计下半年高端高容MLCC价格将继续上涨，并有望推高被动元器件市场整体景气度。（上证报）

headlines.title_en: AI Computing Demand Drives Strong H1 Earnings; MLCC Supply Chain High Momentum to Continue in H2, Industry Insiders Say
headlines.summary_en: Thanks to AI computing demand explosion, MLCCs, known as 'rice of electronics,' have seen tight supply and rising prices since the start of 2026, lifting the passive component sector's cycle. Many listed companies expect H1 earnings to surge, with some up over six times. Looking to H2, industry sources say MLCC prices have been broadly stable since July, but diverged within categories, with AI and automotive-grade high-end high-capacitance products continuing to rise. Amid robust AI server demand, locked-in capacity at OEMs, and high precious metal raw material prices, high-end high-cap MLCC prices are expected to keep rising in H2, potentially boosting overall passive component market sentiment (Shanghai Securities News).
